product.description: Monoprice™Cat6A Ethernet Patch Cable – Bendable, UTP, 30AWGFlexible Routing and Consistent Performance for Demanding InstallationsExperience uncompromising performance and modern design with this Cat6A Ethernet Patch Cable, engineered to deliver reliable, high-speed connectivity for today’s data-driven environments. Whether you’re upgrading a home network, outfitting a professional workspace, or managing dense server racks, this cable is designed to meet the demands of speed, flexibility, and durability.Built to Cat6A specifications, this UTP (Unshielded Twisted Pair) Ethernet patch cable supports bandwidths up to 500MHz and blazing-fast data transfer speeds of up to 10Gbps, ensuring smooth streaming, lag-free gaming, rapid file transfers, and stable connections for bandwidth-intensive applications. It is an ideal solution for connecting routers, switches, modems, patch panels, network printers, IP cameras, gaming consoles, and other Ethernet-enabled devices.The cable features its ultra-slim 30AWG design, making it significantly thinner and lighter than standard Ethernet cables. This slim profile improves airflow in crowded racks, reduces cable clutter, and allows for easier routing through tight spaces, corners, and cable management systems. The cable jacket is engineered to resist everyday abrasion, bending, and frequent plugging and unplugging, making it suitable for both permanent installations and frequent reconfigurations. Gold-plated contacts help improve conductivity and reduce signal loss, ensuring stable and dependable network performance.Compatibility is never a concern.
